category_edits.rationale: Reduce pointwise calibration weight from 0.2 to 0.1 across all four category models so pairwise ranking contributes more strongly. Retain BPR, valid-position averaging, architecture, sampling and training settings; predictor changes are unnecessary.

change_summary: Reduce only the pointwise-loss coefficient from 0.2 to 0.1, preserving one GRU4Rec model per category and existing inference.
